thesis: NO TRADE. THE 23:00 NOTE SET A FALSIFIABLE QUESTION AND THE ANSWER CAME BACK NO. It asked whether a shelf had formed above 766.72 - held with higher lows built on top, not merely touched. IT DID NOT: 766.72 capped price for about twenty-five minutes, then the 15:35Z 5m bar broke it (766.16 -> 763.52), 761.25 broke next, and BNB made a NEW 24h LOW AT 760.09 at 16:00Z. The note's other branch therefore fired - 'if 766.72 BREAKS instead, the next structure is 757.90 then 747.64 and a short finally has a span - RE-RUN THE SCREEN FROM THE NEW LOW' - and this check did exactly that, from new numbers, and THE SHORT STILL FAILED. FOUR INDEPENDENT REFUSALS. (1) L-004 SPAN SCREEN, THE PRIMARY AND NARROWEST REFUSAL OF THE EXPERIMENT. Run BEFORE any ratio, as the lesson requires. The structurally honest stop is 766.72, above the broken 09-21 daily low, i.e. the level at which the breakdown thesis is simply wrong. The NEAREST structural target below is 757.90, the 09-19 daily low. Span between them = 8.82 points on a 761.52 entry = 1.158%. Required = 2.5N + ~0.14% round-trip drag = 2.5 x 0.415 + 0.14 = 1.178%. THE STRUCTURE OFFERS 1.158% WHERE 1.178% IS NEEDED - REFUSED BY 0.020 PERCENTAGE POINTS. That is the thinnest margin the span screen has ever failed by, and it is still a failure: the lesson says that when the structure does not offer the span, STOP COMPUTING, because no entry price rescues it. Reaching 1.5 net requires a 752.65 target, which sits BELOW the 09-19 daily low 757.90 and ABOVE the 09-20 low 747.64 - in the vacuum BETWEEN them, reachable only by jumping 757.90, untested support. A target reached only by jumping intervening structure is not a target. (2) L-002 AT THE DRIFTED ENTRY, DECISIVE FOR AN EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. N was stated THREE ways as the 23:00 note demanded: largest bar of the full preceding hour (15:10Z-16:05Z) = 0.452%, which is the 16:05Z BOUNCE bar and therefore runs AGAINST the short; the setup-defining 15:35Z breakdown bar = 0.415%; excluding both = 0.270%; and including the day's structure-defining 14:10Z flush = 1.846%. EVERY CONSTRUCTION WAS PRICED AGAINST THE HONEST 0.415% - not the flattering 0.270% that exists only because the window rolled, and not the 0.452% bounce bar that would refuse the short for the wrong reason. At the later entry 764.89 the same 766.72 stop is 0.239% = 0.58x N, SUB-NOISE. It is a position size, not a stop, and it is refused however good the number attached to it looks. (3) L-003 REQUOTE - THE STRONGEST INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT, AND THE RESCUE FORM. Five quotes over 164 seconds: BNB bid 761.52 -> 762.22 -> 762.23 -> 764.89 -> 764.89. On a FIXED 766.72 stop and a fixed 757.90 target, net RR went 0.538 -> 2.73, A 5.1x INFLATION PRODUCED ENTIRELY BY THE ENTRY DRIFTING 3.37 POINTS TOWARD THE STOP: risk shrank 5.20 -> 1.83 points AND reward grew 3.62 -> 6.99 points, BOTH HALVES IMPROVING FROM ONE CAUSE, which is the exact signature the lesson names. AND THAT SAME MOVE BROKE THE PREMISE: the drift IS the 16:05Z bar, O761.52 H764.96 L761.52 C764.96 - an unbroken up-bar CLOSING AT ITS HIGH on 470.4M, which reclaimed 762.97 and 764.05 and ended the lower-high sequence 769.49 -> 769.03 -> 768.27 -> 766.70 -> 764.05 -> 762.97 -> 761.64 that was the short's ONLY premise. THE NUMBER CROSSED THE FLOOR AT THE EXACT MOMENT THE TRADE STOPPED EXISTING. This is L-003's strongest stated form - the drift RESCUING a construction that had ALREADY FAILED (0.538, and failed the span screen) rather than merely flattering one that passed - and it is the first time the rescue form has been observed. Re-test clock stays at ZERO; ninth consecutive material check. (4) L-005 REFUSES THE TRADE INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY, EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. Five samples in 164 seconds. A SHORT SELLS INTO THE BID, AND BNB'S BID - THE EXACT SIDE THIS TRADE MUST CROSS - PRINTED 68.6 THEN 99.1 USDT ON TWO CONSECUTIVE SAMPLES, a ~13,400x collapse and ~48,600x recovery in 55 seconds. Against the 2,500 USDT maximum order notional, a maximum-size market sell at those prints is TWENTY-FIVE TIMES THE ENTIRE VISIBLE BID, and the reduce-only stop that would rest on this book between checks cannot be assumed to fill near its trigger. The 23:00 note's ruling that ETH is out on execution is confirmed and the bar is higher, not lower. NOT ONE OF THE FIVE HELD BOTH SIDES QUOTED ACROSS ALL FIVE SAMPLES. *** THE FUNDING FORECAST-VS-OUTCOME TEST, DEFERRED FOUR TIMES, WAS FINALLY RUN - AND ITS RESULT IS THAT THE EXERCISE IS NOT USEFUL. 00:00+08:00 IS 16:00Z, so this slot sat exactly on settlement.
